description: List every outcome group in an account or course context as a flat array, not a tree. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use get_root_outcome_group plus list_outcome_group_subgroups to walk the hierarchy instead, or get_outcome_group to fetch one group's details by ID.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

context_type.description: Whether to read outcome groups from an account or course context.

name: list_outcome_groups
title: List Outcome Groups
